batchTransfer(address,address[],uint256[.details: Sends tokens to multiple recipients in a single transaction

params.amounts: Array of amounts to send to each recipient
params.requireUnique: If true, ensures no duplicate transfers
params.tokenAddress: The address of the ERC20 token to transfer

getTransferCount(address,address).details: Returns the number of transfers between a sender and recipient

getTransferIds(address,address).details: Returns all transfer IDs between a sender and recipient

getTransferInfo(uint256).details: Returns the transfer information for a specific transfer ID

params.transferId: The ID of the transfer to query

returns.token: The address of the token transferred

isTransferExists(address,address,address.details: Checks if a transfer with the given parameters exists

returns._0: True if the transfer exists, false otherwise
